summary: Overdue hiker located and brought out of the Weminuche Wilderness near 30-Mile Campground by Hinsdale County SAR
notes: SNIPPET-SOURCED — verify on next Lake City Silver World rotation: from the Silver World July-2016 issue 'Search & Rescue Leaps into Summer with Four Missions'; the full article is lost to the lakecitysilverworld.com -> .net migration (both URLs now redirect to the current homepage); content captured from the search-indexed July-2016 monthly archive. Mission described as an overdue hiker on June 24 in the Weminuche Wilderness area at 30-Mile Campground. County left blank: 30-Mile Campground sits at Rio Grande Reservoir near the Hinsdale/Mineral line and HCSAR was the responding agency.
